statement: Web UI 与本机能力桥接时，前端提交受 schema/allowlist 约束的结构化任务，而不是任意 shell/FFmpeg 命令；bridge 只暴露最小能力并保持来源、文件和执行权限边界。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record ARCH.STRUCTURED_NATIVE_BRIDGE; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
